timing: New HTTPS connection per attempt; monotonic connect through complete response body; excludes local queue/preparation; retry waits recorded separately
limits: Original eleven tested October 15, 2026; new three tested October 16; not simultaneous sessions
Same original native choice content and full-response timing method; two concurrent requests per model
Microsoft via OpenRouter/Azure; Nimble via Bespoke direct; backend hardware and routes differ
API-reported dollar charges distinguished from Nimble usage-times-tariff calculations; no invoice reconciliation
Nimble response repeats requested version name, not independent hidden-checkpoint attestation
640 core questions plus 496 dependent variants; single shot, unchanged original key, no new key audit
Strict first attempt is primary; no answer-dependent retries; image compatibility probes are not scored image runs
Regular LLM additions tested October 16 with original default-temperature chat protocol, reasoning disabled and max_tokens=16; compatibility probes and earlier pilots excluded.
Provider pins and quantization vary by model. Failures and permitted recovery remain separate; no invoice reconciliation.
GLM 5.3 Flash rejected disabled reasoning and is not assigned a fabricated benchmark score.

October 18 additions use unchanged native choice serialization and full-body HTTPS timer, with two cases per wave and two concurrent requests per model; at most five active native models. They are not contemporaneous reruns of the October 15/16 baselines.
Providers are pinned without fallback. Returned model names are not independent proof of fixed weights. Clef and Clef Flash return undated names.
October 18 HTTP-200 provider error envelopes remain first-attempt failures and are not retried; only transport failures and HTTP 408/429/5xx receive one recovery.

Solar Decide was stopped by the benchmark author for impractical latency after 347 recorded first responses and 348 dispatches. It has no full-bank score; one unresolved response/charge is preserved and must not be replayed.
The prior36-model native-addition stage did not include Tev or these additional ordinary LLM runs; the current expansion adds the separately documented screened chat/native-adapter cohorts.
The question bank contains dependent rotations, contrasts and candidate checks. Overall accuracy is a descriptive result on this bank, not 1136 independent trials.

October18 chat additions were selected using author-approved operational cumulative-prefix gates: accuracy below50%, model-output failures at least5%, or first-attempt median above2000ms causes a hold. Prefixes contain dependent variants and unequal family counts, not independent representative samples.

Only all1136 completed and gate-passing new runs enter the overall model comparison. Stopped samples retain their actual evaluated denominator and are not extrapolated; provider failures remain separate from model-output noncompliance.

Ordinary new LLMs use unchanged original prompt_text plus numeric-only suffix, max_tokens16, pinned provider and disabled reasoning or a natively nonthinking checkpoint. Per-model concurrency2 and two-question barriers match the reference protocol; at most4 ordinary models were active through the controller.

Tev1 uses OpenRouter native decision adaptation because that provider rejected its documented chat interface. Tev1 remains a decision-specialized generative model; native typed output does not establish a non-generative architecture or audit hidden internal processing.

The failed Tev chat and Xing free-route compatibility probes have no benchmark accuracy. Probe charges and unknown charges are accounted separately; no paid format retries or wrong-answer retries were introduced.
The prior36 full-run rows, their costs, timings and archived evidence remain unchanged. New tests are not contemporaneous reruns of those baselines.

publication.rule: Exclude a model from all main rankings, tables and charts when model-output failures are at least 5% of the 1136 planned first attempts. HTTP/transport/upstream error envelopes do not count as model-output failures.
